tools.name: lookup_license
tools.description: Look up one Texas electrician license in the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) file by license number, or by last name plus license type. Returns type, number, county, expiration date, the renewal state, and the fees for an expired license.

tools.name: get_renewal_path
tools.description: Say how a Texas electrician license renews, for a license type and the months since it expired. Returns the window, the fee, the method (online, mail or reapply), and the forms to send.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) electrician forms: id, title, form number, when a person needs it, and the PDF address. Optional filter.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: Get one TDLR electrician form by id: purpose, pages, mailing address, SHA-256 and the date of the last check.

tools.name: check_form_changed
tools.description: Say whether TDLR changed one form since the IERhub mirror was made: the unchanged-since date and any logged change rows.

tools.name: get_license_stats
tools.description: Counts of active licenses and licenses that expire within 3 months, by license type, from the daily Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation (TDLR) file pull.

tools.name: get_course_offer
tools.description: The IERhub 4-hour TDLR approved continuing education course for Texas electricians: name, hours, TDLR course number, prices and the page to buy it.

tools.name: list_license_types
tools.description: The ten Texas electrician license types that IERhub holds renewal fees for: page slug, name, renewal fee and the lookup page.

tools.name: subscribe_alert
tools.description: Start an email alert sign up for one license: 30 and 7 days before it expires, and at each fee step after. Writes a pending record and sends a confirm email. Ask the person first.
